messages.body_plain:
Hi Steffen,

the package needs vdiffr and logcondens (in new) to pass its test suite

Failed with error:  ‘there is no package called ‘logcondens’’
══ testthat results  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[ OK: 8150 | SKIPPED: 12 | WARNINGS: 72 | FAILED: 109 ]
1. Error: are.paired return.paired.rocs smoothes curves with the right method (@test-are-paired.R#113) 
2. Error: Ggroc screenshot looks normal (@test-ggroc.R#9) 
3. Error: Ggroc list screenshot looks normal (@test-ggroc.R#16) 
4. Error: Ggroc list can take multiple aes (@test-ggroc.R#23) 
5. Error: Ggroc list extra aestetics screenshot looks normal (@test-ggroc.R#30) 
6. Error: Ggroc list with group facet screenshot looks normal (@test-ggroc.R#39) 
7. Error: plot draws correctly (@test-plot.R#13) 
8. Error: legacy.axis works correctly (@test-plot.R#25) 
9. Error: Advanced screenshot 1 works correctly (@test-plot.R#47) 
1. ...

Error: testthat unit tests failed

If you do uploads it would help to at least edit the changelog
that makes sense to some reader of an uploaded package for
instance like:

   Test suite will fail due to missing r-cran-logcondens

or so.  If I drop some TODO in d/changelog this *really* should be done
before any upload.  I've noticed that you have the habit to drop TODO
items in d/changelog.  That's IMHO a misuse of d/changelog that records
what actually has been done but not what in the future needs to be done.

Thus, please do not upload with open TODO in d/changelog.  If there
might be really things to do debian/README.source is the file where
developers are communicating about issues with the package.

Thank you

     Andreas.

The excuses page says:

   autopkgtest for r-cran-brms/2.11.0-1: amd64: Regression ♻ , arm64: Regression ♻ 

and refers in the Regression link to

   https://ci.debian.net/data/autopkgtest/testing/amd64/r/r-cran-brms/3988759/log.gz

which has:

...
Get:102 http://deb.debian.org/debian testing/main amd64 r-cran-loo all 2.1.0-1 [2,131 kB]
...

Loading required package: Rcpp
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘brms’:
 object ‘.compute_point_estimate’ is not exported by 'namespace:loo'
Execution halted

That's pretty strange since r-cran-loo has 2.2.0-1 in unstable *and*
testing.  I think it would be wrong to force some versioned Depends
here since r-cran-brms has no explicit dependency from r-cran-loo.
IMHO this issue is caused by a not up to date debci environment for
testing.

That's a bit unfortunate.  The package was accepted but needs a source
only upload to migrate.  I intended to do this just with latest upstream

some more days.

Argh:

   Not built on buildd: arch all binaries uploaded by tille, a new source-only upload is needed to allow migration

IMHO the fact that we can not do source uploads to new but source
upload to testing is a real nuisance and will probably beat us
several times.  Just building and uploading ...

Hi Andreas

On Fri, 24 Jan 2020 at 11:21, Andreas Tille <andreas at an3as.eu> wrote:
> and I have no idea how to fix this.  May be there is some unspecified
> versioned Build-Depends or something like this.

This is the kind of bug that autopkgtests blocking testing migration
is supposed to catch.

I see you uploaded r-cran-recipes 0.1.9+dfsg-2 which should migrate
soon.  Let's see if that improves the situation.  If not, please file
a new bug for r-cran-recipes and leave #949658 for r-cran-rlang.

On the subject of r-cran-rlang, I notice upstream's DESCRIPTION file contains:

Depends: R (>= 3.2.0)
Suggests: cli, covr, crayon, magrittr, methods, pillar, rmarkdown,
        testthat (>= 2.3.0)

This must be where the minimum version of testthat is specified, and
somehow that needs to end up in debian/control or
debian/tests/control.

Regards
Graham
